At src/server/src/ai/gateway/index.ts:28-31, the credential regex does not allow the JSON label's closing quote, encrypted PEM is omitted, and redaction uses original rather than normalized text. Both independent reviewers reproduced dispatch of synthetic examples with mocked Prisma/transport and no external calls. Reject high-confidence credential/private-key representations before attempts, consistently screen/redact normalized lower-confidence tokens without rewriting grounding IDs, and add adversarial cases across narrative, diff, criterion and evidence fields. Live provider mode remains disabled; no real credential disclosure is claimed.

F-002.description: An oversized advertised Content-Length is rejected at transport.ts:41-42 before the body reader is acquired. Both independent synthetic open-stream probes returned INVALID_OUTPUT while bodyCancelled=false and transportSignalAborted=false. Abort/cancel every early transport rejection with bounded cleanup; verify advertised and actual overflow, invalid UTF-8, and deadline during reads leave no live body. No real network call was made.
